prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Design Have a Great Day as the familiar weather-app category standard, executed with exceptional clarity and restraint.
Structure: compact header with Have a Great Day and location search; a polished large current recommendation panel reading exactly "Tomorrow" and "7:00 to 9:00 AM" and "Best for a walk"; one short reason; compact real metrics 24 C, Rain 1%, Air 82 AQI, UV 1.0; a horizontal hourly row; a seven-day daily row; activity and time preferences present but compact.
Style/medium: production-ready consumer weather web app mockup, clean panels, restrained weather icons, excellent spacing and typography.
Color palette: #f7f8f7 background, #172033 text, single #3976c8 blue accent.
Text (verbatim): "Have a Great Day"; "Tomorrow"; "7:00 to 9:00 AM"; "Best for a walk"; "Good air and almost no rain."; "24 C"; "Rain 1%"; "Air 82 AQI"; "UV 1.0".
Constraints: accessible contrast; header under 72px; no fake browser chrome; no giant buttons; no giant Privacy button; no purple gradient; no multicolor card rainbow; no em dash or en dash; no decorative dots; no invented claims.
Avoid: dashboard overload, generic three-card marketing layout, neon, glassmorphism, phone frame, illegible text.
